kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سُكْرُجَة or سُكُرُّجَة or سُكُرَّجَة • (sukruja or sukurruja or sukurraja) f (plural سَكَارِيج (sakārīj))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Middle Persian corresponding to Classical Persian سکرچه (sukarrača). سکرجه (sokarraja), see Persian سکوره (sokure).
g: a kind of small bowl-shaped plate for side dishes, like for sauces for meat, as well as chemistry applications
a weight measure used as well in cookery as in pharmacy of a bowl containing 125 grams
cutting-disk of a threshing-sledge – Schneidscheibe des Dreschschlittens
socket of a door hinge – Angelpfanne einer Tür
